Was, wenn wir unsere ganze Zeit und Kraft nicht mehr investieren würden, um gehört zu werden, sondern die Welt anfängt, uns zu hören? Ein moderner Film über moderne Frauen und Männer - die vielleicht eine gemeinsame Sprache finden können.

overview.de: Barbie spielt Clara, die sich mit einem zum Leben erwachten Nussknacker anfreundet. Als der Mäusekönig die beiden schrumpfen lässt, kann nur die Zuckerfee den Bann brechen.
overview.en: Barbie plays Clara, who befriends a nutcracker that comes to life. When the Mouse King shrinks the duo, only the Sugarplum Fairy can break the spell.

overview.de: Die erfolgreiche Galeristin Susan erhält unerwartet ein Paket von ihrem Ex-Mann Edward, zu dem sie seit Jahren keinen Kontakt mehr hat. Darin befndet sich ein Roman mit dem Titel „Nocturnal Animals“, der Susan gewidmet ist.
overview.en: A writer asks his ex-wife to read a manuscript of his new novel, a troubling story about a family man whose life takes a dark turn.

overview.de: IDLE HANDS
overview.en: IDLE HANDS

overview.de: Der prachtvolle englische Königshof des 16. Jahrhunderts mit all seinen Skandalen wird in dieser Serie über den berüchtigten Tudor-König Henry VIII. zum Leben erweckt.
overview.en: The Tudors will present the rarely dramatized, tumultuous early years of King Henry VIII's nearly 40-year, omnipotent reign (1509-1547) of England. In addition to his famous female consorts, a 20+ year marriage to Catherine of Aragon and the infamous dalliance with Anne Boleyn, the series delves into Henry's most notable political relationship and the deconstruction of the Roman Catholic Church in England.
Glimpse the drama happening in Auradon's hallways.

Selen has dreams of the future, but she never imagined that finding love would be a part of it. When she sees her own death and a stranger saving her, she searches for answers. Meeting Kemal changes not only her fate, but her heart.

overview.de: In 1991, an eccentric teacher and his students exposed a toxic waste conspiracy through a DIY documentary. Decades later, they look back on its impact.
overview.en: In 1991, an eccentric teacher and his students exposed a toxic waste conspiracy through a DIY documentary. Decades later, they look back on its impact.
A fighting tournament takes place to determine the strongest battler among all high school students in Korea.

title.de: Welcome to the Family: The Murder of Dan Markel
title.en: Welcome to the Family: The Murder of Dan Markel

overview.en: How far would you go for your family? The brutal murder of a prominent law professor in Tallahassee, Florida reveals the dark secrets of a wealthy family. A series of larger-than-life suspects leads to a mind-bending story of a murder-for-hire-plot, a messy custody battle, ex-lovers – and family dentistry. With exclusive access to those at the center of this extraordinary story, many of whom have never spoken before, this is the definitive telling of a case which took 11 years to solve.
Record-shattering Korean girl band BLACKPINK tell their story — and detail the hard-fought journey of the dreams and trials behind their meteoric rise.

title.de: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill
title.en: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill

overview.de: Als Mukouda in eine magische Welt transportiert wird, stellt er sich auf ein Abenteuer ein.
overview.en: Mukoda Tsuyoshi, an average salaryman, is summoned to a fantasy world and gains the strange skill "Online Grocery," letting him buy modern food. Though overlooked as useless, his cooking produces powerful effects, attracting legendary familiars and leading him into a relaxed yet dangerous life of travel, monsters, and meals.
Estranged sisters Bea and Phoebe uncover a terrifying truth: Vampires control Berlin.

overview.de: Izabela, der Tochter einer angesehenen Adelsfamilie, fehlt es an nichts, auch nicht an Verehrern. Doch sie will nur eins: über ihr Schicksal selbst entscheiden.
overview.en: A self-made merchant is torn apart by his desire for a strong-willed aristocrat in this modern retelling of the classic Polish novel by Bolesław Prus.

overview.de: Während ihrer Ermittlungen begegnet DI Bea Metcalfe der Archivarin Patience Evans - einer autistisch veranlagten Frau mit einer besonderen Art zu denken und zu beobachten.
overview.en: Patience Evans’ quiet ordered world changes dramatically when she comes to the attention of Detective Bea Metcalf, an intuitive policewoman with an impressive track record but a chaotic private life. Bea recognizes Patience’s unique powers of deduction and wants her on her team. Patience, who has always been fascinated by crime and mystery, finds herself drawn into a new and unpredictable world.

overview.de: Eine Sprinterin, ein Fußballstar und ein Feuerwehrmann. Wer hat das Zeug dazu, jede Herausforderung zu meistern und Mexikos ultimativer Champion zu werden?
overview.en: One hundred competitors from all walks of life battle through grueling physical challenges to determine who will emerge as Mexico's ultimate warrior.
Corinne runs Chénoise prison with her unlikely team: By-the-book Jeff, JP who's always been closer to inmates than colleagues, and rookie Stéphanie. She thinks she can fix everything.
The definitive story of the most influential band of all time, told by The Beatles themselves.

overview.de: Florence Pugh und Harry Styles in einem Psychothriller von Olivia Wilde: Jack arbeitet in den 50ern für das geheime Victory-Projekt. Doch seine Frau Alice hegt Zweifel - und entdeckt Schockierendes.
overview.en: A 1950s housewife (Pugh) living with her husband (Styles) in a utopian experimental community begins to worry that his glamorous company may be hiding disturbing secrets.

overview.de: In diesem fesselnden Psychodrama nimmt die Krankenschwester Nazlı einen neuen Job als Kindermädchen an. Doch alles gerät ins Chaos, als sie den Vater des Kindes wiedererkennt.
overview.en: A nanny with a complicated past comes between a husband and his wife in this steamy psychological drama directed by Mert Baykal ("Yan Yana").

title.de: Monster: Die Geschichte von Lizzie Borden

overview.de: Schikaniert von ihrem Vater (Charlie Hunnam) und ihrer grausamen Stiefmutter (Rebecca Hall) schockiert Lizzie Borden (Ella Beatty) mit einer unvorstellbaren Tat die ganze Welt.
overview.en: From the creators of "Dahmer" and "Ed Gein," this true-crime drama follows Lizzie Borden's journey from naive Victorian daughter to infamous ax murderer.

overview.de: Als eine begabte Notfallchirurgin in der Schönheitsmedizin landet, deckt der Konflikt mit einer Promi-Ärztin die Gier und das Verlangen auf, die hinter dem Glanz stecken.
overview.en: When a gifted ER surgeon is thrust into cosmetic medicine, her clash with a celebrity doctor exposes the greed and desire beneath the glamour.

overview.de: Ein erfolgloser Gangster tut sich mit dem gewieften Sohn eines Politikers zusammen, um dreckige Geheimnisse wichtiger Leute auf beiden Seiten des Gesetzes zu beseitigen.
overview.en: A down-on-his-luck former gangster teams up with a slick politician's son to deal with the dirty secrets of important clients from both sides of the law.

overview.de: Maitreyi Ramakrishnan („Noch nie in meinem Leben …“) und Priyanka Kedia spielen zwei Freundinnen, die versuchen, das erste College-Jahr und die knallharte Tanzszene zu überstehen.
overview.en: Two childhood besties join UCLA's competitive Bollywood-fusion dance team, only to find the road to the US championships is fiercer than they imagined.

overview.de: Eine Radiomoderatorin kurz vor der 40 spielt mit dem Gedanken, alleine ein Kind zu bekommen. Dann bringen eine neue Liebe und ihre chaotische Familie alles durcheinander.
overview.en: Eine Radiomoderatorin kurz vor der 40 spielt mit dem Gedanken, alleine ein Kind zu bekommen. Dann bringen eine neue Liebe und ihre chaotische Familie alles durcheinander.

overview.de: Vier indische Regiegrößen erkunden in dieser Fortsetzung des Emmy-nominierten Films „Lust Stories“ von 2018 Sex, Beziehungen, Lust und Liebe mit weiteren Kurzfilmen.
overview.en: Four eminent Indian directors explore sex, relationships, desire and love through short films in this sequel to 2018's Emmy-nominated "Lust Stories."

overview.de: In der Joseon-Ära weckt ein geheimer Plan verborgene Begierden in einer Adligen, einem Liebhaber und einer Dame, die unwissentlich in das Spiel der zwei verwickelt wird.
overview.en: In Joseon, a secret proposal ignites hidden desires in a gifted noblewoman, a famed lover and an unsuspecting lady caught in their dangerous game.

overview.de: Anwalt Matt Murdock hatte keine einfache Kindheit: Zuerst verlor er sein Augenlicht bei einem Unfall mit radioaktiven Chemikalien und später wurde sein Vater von einem Unbekannten ermordet. Doch bei dem Unfall wurden Matts verbleibende Sinne auf übermenschliche Weise geschärft. Nun tritt er für die Gerechtigkeit ein: Tagsüber als Anwalt und nachts als kostümierter Rächer Daredevil, der freigesprochene Kriminelle heimsucht. Sein größer Gegenspieler ist der Gangsterboss Kingpin und Matt kann nicht verhindern, dass seine große Liebe Elektra Natchios in diesen Privatkrieg hineingezogen wird...
overview.en: Attorney Matt Murdock is blind, but his other four senses function with superhuman sharpness. By day, Murdock represents the downtrodden. At night, he is Daredevil, a masked vigilante, a relentless avenger of justice. When Wilson Fisk hires Bullseye to kill Daredevil, Murdock must rely on his own senses and search out the conspirators against justice, which may include his own girlfriend, Elektra.
An exposé on the "green gold" rush for Ethiopian farmland and its human cost.

overview.de: Actionkomödie mit einem schmerzbefreiten Jack Quaid: Nathan muss seinen Schwarm Sherry vor Geiselnehmern retten. Gut, dass der Mann wegen eines Gendefekts keine Schmerzen spürt.
overview.en: When the girl of his dreams gets kidnapped, a man turns his inability to feel pain into an unexpected advantage. He fights a bunch of thugs to get her back.

overview.de: Seth MacFarlane („Family Guy") hat eine neue Kultfigur geschaffen: Ted, der abgefahrenste Teddybär, der jemals lebte.
overview.en: HD. Mark Wahlberg has his romance with lovely Mila Kunis imperiled by his lifelong friendship with a hard-partying teddy bear in this comedy.

overview.de: Fortsetzung der abgedrehten Bad-Taste-Komödie mit noch mehr Starpower. - Teddybär Ted hat sein Glück gefunden: Er heiratet seine geliebte Supermarkt-Kassiererin Tami-Lynn (Jessica Barth). Die Ehe seines alten "Donnerbuddys" John Bennett (Mark Wahlberg), der Ted einst mit seinem Wunsch zum Leben erweckte, ist derweil zerbrochen. Aber als Ted Vater werden will, soll er plötzlich beweisen, dass er eine Person ist. Sonst wird er nicht nur seine Ehe und seinen Job, sondern auch seine Bürgerrechte verlieren. Ted und John suchen die Hilfe der jungen Anwältin Samantha L. Jackson (Amanda Seyfried).
overview.en: Teddy bear Ted seeks legal help from a young lawyer and a legendary civil-rights attorney when the law declares him to be property and not a person.

overview.de: Eine dramatische Geschichte von Liebe und Überleben zu Beginn des Bürgerkriegs. Nicole Kidman, Jude Law und Renée Zellweger spielen im fesselnden und ergreifenden Film des Oscar-Gewinners Anthony Minghellas (THE ENGLISH PATIENT) mit.
overview.en: A dramatic tale of love and survival set at the dawn of the Civil War. Nicole Kidman, Jude Law and Renée Zellweger star in Academy Award winning director Anthony Minghella's (THE ENGLISH PATIENT) captivating and poignant film.

title.de: As Good As Dead - So gut wie tot

overview.en: When the leader of a religious cult is slain, his vengeful followers abduct and torture his alleged killer, but quickly learn they got the wrong man.

overview.de: Robert Pattinson geht in dieser Sci-Fi-Satire als Freiwilliger auf tödliche Missionen - und wird nach seinem Ableben neu geklont. Bis er plötzlich doppelt existiert. Vom "Parasite"-Regisseur.
overview.en: From the Academy Award-winning writer/director of "Parasite," Bong Joon Ho, comes his next groundbreaking cinematic experience, Mickey 17. The unlikely hero, Mickey Barnes (Robert Pattinson) has found himself in the extraordinary circumstance of working for an employer who demands the ultimate commitment to the job... to die, for a living.
A group of aspiring actors and writers in Hollywood make ends meet by working for a Los Angeles catering company. The crew learn a lot from the different events they are sent to each week.

In the final series of A Discovery of Witches, Matthew and Diana return from their trip to 1590 to find tragedy at Sept-Tours. They must find the missing pages from the Book of Life and the Book before it's too late. Their enemies are gearing up against them, and a monster from Matthew's past who has been lying in wait will return for revenge.

Yuki Itose is just a typical student dealing with the pressures of college. She is struggling one day on the train when an upperclassman named Itsuomi Nagi helps her out. As he gradually opens a new world to her, Yuki develops feelings for Itsuomi. A pure love story begins to grow.

title.en: Asterix and Obelix Take On Caesar

overview.en: In 50 B.C., Roman soldiers set their sights on a secret elixir that has made mighty warriors out of the last village the empire has yet to conquer.

title.en: Maya the Bee: The Honey Games

overview.en: Following an unproductive harvest season, it’s up to Maya and her brave friends to save their hive by competing in a series of games.

overview.de: Eine Juraprofessorin will die Unschuld eines verurteilten Mannes mithilfe Ihrer Studierendengruppe beweisen, von der ein Mitglied mit ihrer Vergangenheit in Verbindung steht.
overview.en: A renowned law professor leads a team of students to prove a convicted man's innocence, only to discover her brightest pupil is bound to her past.

overview.de: Bleigeladenes Actiongewitter: Als ehemaliger Killer der russischen Mafia kehrt Keanu Reeves in den New Yorker Untergrund zurück und schwört erbarmungslose Rache. - Früher war John Wick (Keanu Reeves) der berüchtigtste Killer der russischen Mafia in New York. Nach dem Tod seiner Frau lebt er zurückgezogen in einer Luxusvilla. Als eines Nachts der Sohn seines ehemaligen Chefs Viggo Tarasov (Michael Nyqvist) seinen Hund tötet und Wick selbst schwer verletzt, erwacht in ihm erneut der Killerinstinkt. Ausgestattet mit einem riesigen Waffenarsenal sinnt John auf Vergeltung.
overview.en: A legendary hit man comes out of retirement to go on a ruthless rampage of revenge against the sadistic punks who attacked him.

overview.de: Eigentlich wollte sich Profikiller Wick gerade zur Ruhe setzen, doch Mafioso Santino macht ihm einen Strich durch die Rechnung, als er die Einlösung einer Schuldmünze einfordert. Wick soll Santinos Schwester Gianna töten, die einen Sitz in einem globalen Verbrechersyndikat hält, den ihr Bruder gerne selbst hätte. Bald erfährt Wick zudem, dass es die halbe Verbrecherwelt auf ihn abgesehen hat.
overview.en: Legendary hit man John Wick is forced out of retirement by a former associate plotting to seize control of a shadowy international assassins guild.

overview.de: Jetzt wollen alle seinen Kopf: Hitman Keanu Reeves fightet in Teil 3 der Actionsaga kompromissloser denn je. Im Killer-Krieg gelten für den Outlaw und die verbündete Halle Berry keine Regeln mehr.
overview.en: Super-assassin John Wick is on the run after killing a member of the international assassin's guild, and with a $14 million price tag on his head - he is the target of hit men and women everywhere.
Max Verstappen has to beat 100 celebs and creators in the world’s biggest game of chase.

title.de: The Rising of the Shield Hero
title.en: The Rising of the Shield Hero

overview.de: Ein Gamer wird durch Magie in eine Parallelwelt berufen. Dort muss er als einer von vier auserwählten Helden versuchen, die Welt vor dem vorhergesagten Untergang zu bewahren.
overview.en: Known as the weakest of four heroes, the Shield Hero, Naofumi is tasked with defending the world from calamity. But when he ends up betrayed and belittled from the start, will this cynic even be willing to help?

overview.de: Die Spielzeuge sind zurück in Disney und Pixar's „Toy Story 5 und dieses Mal heißt es: Spielzeug trifft High-Tech. Woody, Buzz, Jessie und ihre Freunde sehen sich plötzlich mit ganz neuen Herausforderungen konfrontiert, als sie Lilypad begegnen- einem neuen Tablet-Gerät, das ziemlich verändernde Ideen hat, was für ihr Kind Bonnie das Beste ist. Wird das Spielen jemals wieder so sein wie früher?
overview.en: The toys are back in Disney and Pixar's "Toy Story 5," and this time it's Toy meets Tech. Woody, Buzz, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs are challenged when they come face-to-face with Lilypad, a brand-new tablet device that arrives with her own disruptive ideas about what is best for their kid, Bonnie. Will playtime ever be the same?

overview.de: Willy Wonkas Schokoladenfabrik erwacht in diesem kreativen Reality-Wettbewerb zum Leben, bei dem Teams mit unvorhersehbaren Spielen, Prüfungen und Versuchungen konfrontiert werden.
overview.en: In this reality competition inspired by "Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory," players enter a world of pure imagination to win a life-changing prize.

overview.de: Eine Erstsemester-Studentin und ihre besten Freund*innen meistern den Spagat zwischen Studium, Liebesdrama und Familienerbe an einem traditionsreichen Schwarzen College.
overview.en: A freshman and her ride-or-die crew juggle school, romantic drama and family legacy at a historically Black college.

overview.de: Emma kann die Toten sehen, wozu auch ihre Mutter gehört. Doch die Ankunft ihrer Nichte erschüttert Tausende von Leben. Eine Dramaserie nach Mariana Enriquez' Erzählungen. Von Regisseur Pablo Larraín mit Mercedes Morán und Dolores Fonzi.
overview.en: Emma can see the dead. But when her niece arrives, thousands of lives are shaken in this chilling miniseries based on Mariana Enriquez's works.

overview.de: Seit der Entführung ihres Neugeborenen vor neun Jahren sucht die Mutter unermüdlich nach ihm. Dabei deckt sie Geheimnisse auf, die sie an der Realität zweifeln lassen.
overview.en: Anvita's daughter is abducted on the day she is born. Years later, anonymous clues uncover a web of lies surrounding her disappearance.
What does a curious little droid do when he's not on a daring mission to save the galaxy?

overview.de: Ein Vater reist in dieser Wohlfühl-Dramakomödie nach wahren Begebenheiten mit seinem autistischen Sohn kreuz und quer durch Deutschland, um dessen Lieblingsfußballverein zu finden.
overview.en: Un joven desubicado quien apuesta y bebe, acepta ser el entrenador de un equipo de las pequeñas ligas de Cambrini Green en Chicago como condición de un préstamo que le hizo un amigo.

overview.de: Das Leben einer Frau gerät aus den Fugen, als ihr demenzkranker Vater unter Mordverdacht steht und die Dorfbewohner*innen glauben, er sei von einem bösen Geist besessen.
overview.en: A woman's life spirals when her father's dementia makes him a prime suspect in a murder — and the villagers believe he's possessed by a malevolent ghost.

overview.de: AFTER LOVE erzählt die epische Liebesgeschichte von Tessa und Hardin weiter. In den Hauptrollen überzeugen erneut die beiden Jung-Stars Josephine Langford und Hero Fiennes Tiffin.
overview.en: The third installment of the AFTER franchise finds Tessa starting an exciting new chapter of her life. But as she prepares to move to Seattle for her dream job, Hardin’s jealousy and unpredictable behavior reach a fever pitch and threaten to end their intense relationship.

overview.de: Die Brave und das Biest: College-Frischling Tessa verliebt sich an der Uni in einen geheimnisvollen Bad Boy. Kann das gutgehen? Teenager-Romanze nach der Bestsellerreihe von Anna Todd.
overview.en: Tessa, a dedicated student, dutiful daughter, and loyal girlfriend to her high-school sweetheart, as she enters her first semester in college armed with grand ambitions for her future. Her guarded world opens up when she meets the dark, mysterious Hardin Scott, a magnetic, brooding rebel who makes her question all she thought she knew about herself and what she wants from life.

overview.de: Spin-off der leidenschaftlichen Beziehung von Tessa und Hardin: Tessa findet die Wahrheit über ihren Ex-Freund Hardin heraus und ist sehr verletzt. Nach all den Demütigungen möchte sie wieder bei Null anfangen. Kurz darauf lernt sie Trevor kennen.
overview.en: A collegian's relationship gets put to the test when she meets another man who's attracted to her.
When Cleopatra sets out to build a new temple to win a bet with Julius Caesar, Gauls Asterix and Obelix must step in to help thwart Roman sabotage.
After countless beatings by Asterix and Obelix, the Romans decide to kidnap the druid Getafix in the hope of getting the secret formula for his magic potion.

Gallic heroes Asterix and Obelix take on the might of the Roman Empire. When Julius Caesar finally fears that he may never be able to defeat Asterix and conquer his village, he comes up with a deal; if they can pass twelve of his chosen tasks, the whole of the Roman Empire will be theirs. If not, they must surrender.

title.de: Asterix und das Geheimnis des Zaubertranks
title.en: Asterix: The Secret of the Magic Potion

overview.en: After elderly druid Getafix falls out of a tree, he resolves to find a young successor to whom he can entrust the secret formula for the magic potion that makes his village the only one in Gaul still unconquered by the Romans.

title.de: Auf in den Westen, Lucky Luke!
title.en: Go West: A Lucky Luke Adventure

overview.en: Dos mujeres lidian con las consecuencias de sus revelaciones cuando sus respectivos padres les dan noticias incómodas sobre su propia vida sexual.
Two families build a hot-air balloon to escape East Germany in 1979, but their crash just short of the border leads to an extreme race against time.

overview.de: A 17-year-old girl is found burned and dismembered in an empty lot in a middle-class neighborhood of Santiago, Chile. Due to police negligence, the crime goes unpunished until thirty years later, when the family manages to piece together the murder puzzle, revealing a forbidden relationship and a cruel truth.
overview.en: A 17-year-old girl is found burned and dismembered in an empty lot in a middle-class neighborhood of Santiago, Chile. Due to police negligence, the crime goes unpunished until thirty years later, when the family manages to piece together the murder puzzle, revealing a forbidden relationship and a cruel truth.

overview.de: Eine junge FBI-Agentenanwärterin muss sich einem inhaftierten und manipulativen Mörder anvertrauen, um von ihm die notwendige Hilfe zu erhalten, einen anderen Serienmörder fassen zu können, der seinen Opfern die Haut abzieht.
overview.en: A young FBI trainee must earn the trust of a brilliant psychopath to uncover the identity of an elusive serial killer on the loose.

Charlotte is about to turn 30, and the people closest to her won’t let her forget it. With a waitressing job as monotonous as her dating life, Charlotte is ready for a change. One night, she meets Adam, a handsome and soulful painter who seems just as lost as she feels. Their instant connection turns into a midnight drink and then a whirlwind romance of contemplation and tantalization.

title.de: Dil Chahta Hai – Freunde wie wir

overview.en: Three friends share a deep bond until their differences and relationships drive them apart. When they reunite years later, they face difficult decisions.

title.de: Dil Dhadakne Do - Ozean der Träume

overview.en: While hosting a shipboard holiday for relatives and friends, a wealthy but dysfunctional family must face the ugly truths under their flawless facade.
A simple man from the city of Mumbai is recruited by a police officer to masquerade as the Don, the leader of an international gang of smugglers.
With Asia under his complete control, criminal mastermind Don turns to Europe, battling the mob bosses of each nation along the way.

overview.de: Der Job von Driver ist eigentlich aufregend genug – tagsüber verdient er sein Geld als Stuntfahrer in Hollywood und er ist der Beste seines Fachs. Doch gilt dasselbe auch für seine nächtliche Tätigkeit als Fluchtwagenfahrer.
overview.en: A Hollywood stunt performer who moonlights as a wheelman discovers that a contract has been put on him after a heist gone wrong.

overview.de: Die junge Alma Lancaster aus gutem Hause lebt heimlich ein Jahr lang ihren Uni-Traum vom Filmemachen, während ihre Eltern glauben, sie studiere Jura. Als sie mit dem mysteriösen Vadim Arcadi zusammenarbeiten muss, funkt es zwischen ihnen heftig. Doch ein Unbekannter droht, ihr Geheimnis ans Licht zu bringen.
overview.en: Unbeknownst to her parents, who believe she's studying law, Alma Lancaster, a young woman from a good family, has given herself a year to pursue her dream of making movies. When she's forced to work with Vadim Arcadi, a young man with few ties, an electric attraction sparks between them. But lurking behind the scenes is an invisible threat determined to tear them apart and expose everything…

overview.de: Eine realitätsnahe Liebesgeschichte über ein Paar, das seit zehn Jahren zusammen ist und durch unerwartete Gefühle auf die Probe gestellt wird.
overview.en: A realistic, emotionally resonant romance about a couple in their tenth year together whose comfortable relationship is tested by unexpected feelings.

title.de: En coma - Zwischen Leben und Tod

overview.de: Der Mount Everest – ein Mythos und gleichzeitig eines der größten Abenteuer unseres Planeten. Für die Teilnehmer zweier Expeditionen ist er die Herausforderung ihres Lebens. Als die beiden erfahrenen Bergsteiger Scott Fischer und Rob Hall mit ihren Gruppen die Gipfelerstürmung in Angriff nehmen, entwickelt sich diese nach einem überraschenden Wetterwechsel zum Kampf ums Überleben.
overview.en: Everest documents the deadly journey of two mountain climbing expeditions challenged beyond their limits by one of the fiercest snowstorms ever encountered by mankind.

Billionaire Kabir Malhotra (Anupam Kher) appears to have committed suicide while on an island with four of his guests. The Key word here being "appears". The guests including Neil Menon (Abhishek Bachchan) who flocked there eagerly do not seem very excited now. With no one to blame and everyone a suspect, investigating officer Sia Agnihotri (Kangana Ranaut) has her work cut out for her.

overview.de: USA, 1953. Senator Joseph McCarthy inszeniert eine landesweite Hexenjagd gegen vermeintliche Kommunisten, klagt Unschuldige in Schauprozessen an und zerstört ganze Existenzen. Doch Fernsehmoderator Edward R. Murrow (David Strathairn) lässt sich nicht einschüchtern.
overview.en: Good Night, And, Good Luck. takes place during the early days of broadcast in 1950's America. It chronicles the real-life conflict between Edward R. Murrow and Senator Joseph McCarthy.

title.de: Gott, du kannst ein Arsch sein!
Happy Gilmore - Ein Champ zum Verlieben

overview.de: Adam Sandler lässt auf dem Green die Sau raus: Eishockey-Rüpel Happy Gilmore entdeckt seine Golf-Schlagkraft - und will mit einem Turniersieg das Haus seiner Oma retten.
overview.en: A rejected hockey player becomes a golf star.

overview.de: New York, 1961: Llewyn Davis lebt für die Folkmusik, doch der große Durchbruch lässt auf sich warten. Während sich in den Clubs von Greenwich Village aufstrebende Musiker die Klinke in die Hand geben, pendelt Llewyn zwischen kleinen Gigs und Songaufnahmen. Nacht für Nacht sucht er einen neuen Platz zum Schlafen und landet dann meist bei befreundeten Musikern wie Jim und Jane, mit denen ihn mehr als eine oberflächliche Freundschaft verbindet. Doch Llewyn kann seine Gefühle nur in der Musik und nicht im echten Leben äußern, und so lässt er sich weitertreiben - von New York bis Chicago und wieder zurück, ganz wie die Figuren in den Folksongs.
overview.en: The Coen brothers helm this chronicle of struggling musician Llewyn Davis, set during the height of the folk era in the early 1960s.

title.de: Jo Koy: Blue in the Face
title.en: Jo Koy: Blue in the Face

overview.de: In dieser lustigen, rührenden Show erzählt Jo Koy von einem Zahnarzt-Trauma, seinem Stiefvater, einem Veteranen, und wie er einst bei McDonald's gefeuert wurde.
overview.en: Jo Koy relives a wild dental disaster, recounts getting fired from McDonald's and celebrates his veteran stepdad in this hilariously heartfelt set.

overview.de: Motiviert durch neuen Glauben an die Menschen und inspiriert von Supermans selbstloser Handlung, rekrutieren Batman und Wonder Woman Metamenschen, um eine neue Bedrohung zu bekämpfen.
overview.en: Batman and Wonder Woman recruit an unprecedented league of heroes to battle a newly awakened enemy.
Unlucky in love and bullied at work, an office drone is resigned to his dead-end life until it’s transformed by mysterious calls from … himself.

overview.de: Quan spielt Marvin Gable, einen Immobilienmakler in einem Vorort von Milwaukee, wo Verkaufsschilder sprießen. Gable erhält einen Brief von Rose (Ariana DeBose), einer ehemaligen Verbündeten, die er dem Tod überlassen hatte. Sie ist stinksauer. Marvin wird in die Welt skrupelloser Auftragsmörder zurückversetzt, in der Verrat herrscht und Hausbesichtigungen zu tödlichen Schlachtfeldern werden.
overview.en: When Marvin left behind a violent life to hide in suburban Milwaukee as a mild-mannered realtor, he also left his former partner in crime, Rose. Now she's back and wants Marvin to help take revenge against his crime lord brother, Knuckles. Like it or not, Marvin is pulled back into a wild world where he'll need his lethal fighting skills, wit, and heroism to survive and save the day.

title.de: Luck by Chance – Liebe, Glück und andere Zufälle

overview.en: When Vikram gets tapped to play the male lead in a Bollywood film, he can't believe his luck. But it may ruin his relationship with his girlfriend.

title.en: Lucky Luke: Daltons on the Loose

overview.en: Three friends on an adventurous road trip/bachelor party in Spain learn some lessons about themselves and each other that will change them forever.

overview.de: Der MMA-Kämpfer Cole Young sucht die größten Champions der Erde, um sich in einem hochriskanten Kampf um das Universum mit den Feinden von Outworld zu messen.
overview.en: MMA fighter Cole Young is unaware of his heritage or why Outworld Emperor Shang Tsung has sent warrior Sub-Zero to hunt him down. Fearing for his family, Cole turns to Sonya Blade at the direction of Jax, a Special Forces Major bearing the same dragon marking Cole was born with. He finds himself at the temple of Elder God Lord Raiden, protector of Earthrealm, who grants sanctuary to those bearing the mark. Cole trains with Liu Kang, Kung Lao and mercenary Kano to stand with Earth's greatest champions against the enemies from Outworld in a high-stakes battle for the universe. But will Cole be pushed hard enough to unlock his arcana, the immense power from within his soul, in time to save his family and stop Outworld once and for all?

title.de: Mullewapp - Das große Kinoabenteuer der Freunde

overview.de: In diesem Oscar-nominierten Drama von Steven Spielberg macht sich eine Gruppe von Männern nach dem Anschlag auf die Olympischen Spiele 1972 auf eine gefährliche Mission.
overview.en: Viisi agenttia valitaan eliminoimaan vuoden 1972 olympialaisten murhista vastuussa olevat henkilöt.
A lazy rich kid and his friends join the army but drop out before completing training. Having brought shame upon himself and his family, Karan returns to the army to prove himself.

overview.de: Kurz bevor sie das Haus verliert, in dem sie aufgewachsen ist, entdeckt Maddie (JENNIFER LAWRENCE) ein faszinierendes Jobangebot: Wohlhabende Helikopter-Eltern suchen für ihren introvertierten, 19-jährigen Sprössling Percy (ANDREW FELDMAN) eine Frau, die ihn „datet“, ehe er daheim auszieht, um aufs College zu gehen. Zu ihrer großen Überraschung muss Maddie jedoch feststellen, dass sie den...
overview.en: On the brink of losing her childhood home, Maddie (Lawrence) discovers an intriguing job listing: wealthy helicopter parents looking for someone to "date" their introverted 19-year-old son, Percy, before he leaves for college. To her surprise, Maddie soon discovers the awkward Percy is no sure thing.

title.de: O Brother, Where Art Thou? - Eine Mississippi-Odyssee

overview.de: Mississippi der 30er Jahre: Drei Sträflinge fliehen aus einem Arbeitslager.
overview.en: A mysterious lawman tracks three escaped convicts (George Clooney, John Turturro, Tim Blake Nelson) searching for buried treasure in 1930s Mississippi.

overview.de: Jack Harper (Tom Cruise) ist einer der wenigen Drohnentechniker, die noch auf der Erde stationiert sind. Nach jahrzehntelangem Krieg mit den schreckenerregenden Plünderern nimmt er am gewaltigen Einsatz teil, lebenswichtige Erdressourcen abzubauen. Jacks Auftrag geht zu Ende. Er lebt in atemberaubender Höhe und überwacht den Himmel auf Patrouillen. Die Rettung einer schönen Fremden aus eine...
overview.en: A stranger's arrival triggers a battle to save mankind.

overview.de: Auf einer Routine-Weltraumreise zu einem neuen Zuhause werden zwei Passagiere, die im Kälteschlaf liegen, 90 Jahre zu früh geweckt, als es bei ihrem Raumschiff zu einer Fehlfunktion kommt. Jim und Aurora müssen sich der Aussicht stellen, dass sie den Rest ihres Lebens an Bord verbringen werden, mit jedem Luxus, den sie sich nur wünschen können. Sie fangen an, sich ineinander zu verlieben, zu ...
overview.en: Jennifer Lawrence and Chris Pratt star in a high-stakes adventure about two passengers, Jim and Aurora, onboard a spaceship transporting them to a new life on another planet. The trip takes a deadly turn when their hibernation pods mysteriously wake them 90 years before they reach their destination. As they try to unravel the mystery behind the malfunction, they begin to fall for each other...

overview.de: Anna Kendrick will als College-Frischling die A-Cappela-Gruppe "The Bellas" aufmöbeln und zum Sieg der Meisterschaften führen. Schwungvoller College-Musikspaß mit coolen Pop-Hits.
overview.en: College student Beca is persuaded into joining her school's all-girls singing group, The Bellas. Injecting some much-needed energy into their repertoire, they take on their male rivals in a fight to the top of college music competitions.

overview.de: Die Chaos-Sängerinnen um Anna Kendrick und Rebel Wilson müssen bei einem A-Cappella-Wettbewerb gegen starke Gegnerinnen antreten. Fortsetzung des Überraschungs-Hits.
overview.en: The Barden Bellas are back in Pitch Perfect 2, the follow-up to 2012's smash hit. The comedy is helmed by Elizabeth Banks, co-star and producer of Pitch Perfect.

overview.de: Im Jahr 2045, der Virtual-Reality-Welt, ist die OASIS die Zukunft. Begleiten Sie Wade & seine Freunde auf der digitalen Schatzsuche durch ein Universum voller Geheimnisse und Gefahren.
overview.en: A virtual reality universe's creator leaves his fortune for the first to find a digital Easter egg.

overview.de: Eine wahre Geschichte über Flucht, Familie, Musik und den Mythos um einen Goldraub. Erzählt nach der Autobiografie von Xatar.
overview.en: Xatar’s path from the ghetto to the top of the music charts is a dramatic adventure story. From the hell of an Iraqi prison, Giwar Hajabi came to Germany as a young boy with his family in the mid-1980s and landed at the very bottom. There were opportunities, but many more stumbling blocks. In no time, he went from a petty criminal to a big-time dealer. Until a shipment goes missing. To settle his debts with the cartel, Giwar plans a legendary gold heist.
Aditya, Joe, Kedar, and Rob form a rock band but break up when they fail to succeed. They lead regular lives until deciding to reunite and take another shot at fulfilling their dreams.

title.de: Sammys Abenteuer - Die Suche nach der geheimen Passage

overview.en: A young sea turtle embarks on a lifelong ocean journey, facing dangers, making friends, and discovering the world while searching for his true path.

title.en: A Turtle's Tale 2: Sammy's Escape from Paradise

overview.en: Nabbed by poachers and shipped to an aquarium in Dubai, Sammy and Ray plot a daring escape while their hatchlings devise their own rescue plan.
As gene therapy, transplants and cloning offer hope for humanity, a dark side of evolution produces monsters a select few are brave enough to take on.

After their adventures in Malia, English teens - sex-obsessed horndog Jay, dim-witted nice guy Neil, loyal but neurotic Simon and sarcastic hero Will - hit Australia to party, hit on girls and maybe learn something about themselves.

overview.de: Robert Downey Jr. und Jude Law jagen als Holmes und Watson mit Logik, Witz und Muckis einen Ritualmörder. Actionreiches Update der Krimilegende von Kultregisseur Guy Ritchie.
overview.en: Robert Downey Jr. transforms the legendary detective into an athletic Victorian action hero in this exciting thriller.

title.en: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows

overview.de: Sherlock Holmes und sein Partner Dr. Watson tun sich zusammen, um ihren größten Gegner, Professor Moriarty, zu überlisten und zu besiegen.
overview.en: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes (Robert Downey Jr.) deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius.

title.de: Spidey and the Avengers: Halloween Team-Up!
title.en: Spidey and the Avengers: Halloween Team-Up!

overview.de: Die erfolgreiche, englische Schriftstellerin Sarah Morton leidet an Depressionen und daraus resultierend an einer Schreibblockade. Deshalb schlägt ihr Verleger, John, ihr vor, den Sommer in seiner Villa in Frankreich zu verbringen. Sarah nimmt dankend an, doch schon am ersten Tag taucht Johns angebliche Tochter auf dem Anwesen auf. Julie, die jede Nacht einen neuen Liebhaber mit ins Haus bringt, geht Sarah zuerst sehr auf die Nerven, doch dann merkt sie, was für eine große Inspiration die junge Lolita für sie ist. Doch als diese eines Abends den Keller Franck mit in die Villa bringt und dieser mehr an Sarah als an der jungen Frau interessiert ist, nimmt das Unheil seinen Lauf.
overview.en: A British author suffering from a writing block seeks inspiration and solitude at her publisher’s house in the South of France. When his daughter unexpectedly appears, her reckless, erotic lifestyle disrupts the author’s quietude. Their tumultuous interactions set off a series of disturbing events.

overview.de: Adam Clay führt ein zurückgezogenes Leben als Bienenzüchter. Als seine beste Freundin Eloise Opfer von Betrügern wird, zeigt er sein wahres Gesicht und macht Jagd auf die Drahtzieher, die für den Vorfall verantwortlich sind.
overview.en: A man's brutal campaign for vengeance takes on national stakes after it's revealed he's a former operative of a powerful and clandestine organization.

title.de: The Good Guy – Wenn der Richtige der Falsche ist

overview.en: Dating rules spin out of control as an ambitious Manhattanite falls for the sensitive and handsome coworker of her Wall Street hot shot boyfriend.

title.de: The Last Stop in Yuma County
title.en: The Last Stop in Yuma County

overview.en: While stranded at a rural Arizona rest stop, a traveling salesman is thrust into a dire hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers with no qualms about using cruelty-or cold, hard steel-to protect their bloodstained fortune.
Richard Hammond hosts a hilarious look-back at all that Top Gear has tried to accomplish, featuring iconic and ambitious challenges.
Six newly-married, diverse honeymooning couples face marital bliss and discord, finding out more about themselves, their significant others and life.

Julian Michaels (Bruce Willis) has designed the ultimate resort: VICE, where anything goes and customers can play out their wildest fantasies with artificial inhabitants who look, think and feel like humans. When an artificial becomes self-aware, she escapes and finds herself in the crossfire between Julian's mercenaries and a cop who is hell-bent on stopping the violence and shutting Vice down.

overview.de: Nachdem der Test einer Massenvernichtungswaffe des US-Militärs eine halbe Million Menschen das Leben gekostet hat, erwachen einige der Todesopfer wieder zum Leben. Zu den Freiwilligen, die das betroffene Gebiet auf der Suche nach Leichen durchkämmen, gehört auch Ava. Doch die angeblich harmlosen Untoten werden nicht nur immer mehr, sondern mit jeder Stunde gewalttätiger und aggressiver ...
overview.en: After a catastrophic military disaster, the dead don’t just rise - they hunt. Ava (Daisy Ridley) searches for her missing husband, but what she finds is far more terrifying.

title.de: Wie werde ich ihn los - in 10 Tagen?
title.en: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days

overview.de: Eine Ratgeber-Kolumnistin verpflichtet sich, einen Erfahrungsbericht darüber zu verfassen, wie man einen Mann aus seinem Leben vertreibt... in genau 10 Tagen.
overview.en: A columnist (Kate Hudson) tries to make a man (Matthew McConaughey) dump her.
People begin to vanish in the French countryside, and a teenage girl vows to find them.

overview.de: Ein Vater reist in dieser rührenden Dramedy mit seinem autistischen Sohn kreuz und quer durchs Land, um dessen Lieblingsfußballverein zu finden.
overview.en: Un joven desubicado quien apuesta y bebe, acepta ser el entrenador de un equipo de las pequeñas ligas de Cambrini Green en Chicago como condición de un préstamo que le hizo un amigo.

overview.de: „Wonka" erzählt die wundersame Geschichte, wie aus dem größten Erfinder, Zauberkünstler und Chocolatier der Welt der geliebte Willy Wonka wurde, den wir heute kennen.
overview.en: Young chocolatier Willy Wonka manages to change the world, one delectable bite at a time.

overview.de: In ZACH SNYDER’S JUSTICE LEAGUE stellt Bruce Wayne ein Team von Metamenschen zusammen, um die Welt vor einer nahenden Bedrohung katastrophalen Ausmaßes zu beschützen.
overview.en: In Zack Snyder's Justice League, Bruce Wayne aligns forces recruiting a team of metahumans to protect the world from an approaching threat of catastrophic proportions.

overview.de: Comedian Zakir Khan schöpft aus seiner Kindheit und packt in diesem Stand-up-Special herrlich komische und herzerwärmende Erinnerungen an seinen Vater aus.
overview.en: Comedian Zakir Khan celebrates one of the most relatable bonds in Indian families — between fathers and sons — in this heartwarming, hilarious special.
A police officer investigates the death of a film star in a fatal car accident, but must first deal with his own suppressed grief.
Four young male friends tackle the challenges and unexpected catastrophes of growing up clueless in this music-packed Bollywood teen drama.

Two ordinary men, from two different religion, are separately trained to become terrorists in Bangistan. Both their mentors encourage them to suicide-bomb the International Peace Conference. What follows thereafter is a chain of ridiculous events that finally sends across a universally positive message that all religions are the same.

title.de: A Champion Heart - Freunde fürs Leben

overview.en: A troubled teenage girl struggling with grief finds faith, hope, and healing through forming a relationship with a wounded horse.
The love between a businessman and his wife is tested, when she contracts a merciless disease that will either cement or destroy their marriage.

Hollywood heavyweights John Wayne and Richard Widmark star in this historically inaccurate tale of how a handful of Texans defended their mission against a 7,000-strong Mexican army. The climactic battle scenes are stunning.

title.de: Alice - Im Wunderland der bösen Träume

overview.en: A young woman who leaves her husband one stormy night soon finds herself lost and trapped inside a fantastic paradox that defies all reality.
In this homage to 1950s sci-fi movies, a plucky waitress and an earthbound alien team up to stop a bug-eyed monster from destroying mankind.

When Andre, 85, has a stroke, his daughter Emmanuèle hurries to her father's bedside. When he wakes up diminished and dependent, this vital and curious man who loves life asks his daughter to help him end his life.
On a mission to rescue the Air Force One from the Bermuda Triangle, the Navy awakens a mysterious creature that threatens to destroy them all.

A Hallmark Channel original movie. A speech writer (Tyler Hynes) makes a deal with his ex-girlfriend (Bethany Joy Lenz) to pretend they’re a couple to save his family’s Christmas. It’s not long before both the ruse and their feelings catch up with them.

overview.de: Nach den verheerenden Meerjungfrau-Kriegen wird die einst mächtige Stadt von Iliad von dunklen Mächten belagert. Ein berühmter Fabelwesen-Jäger und der Assassine Atticus müssen gegen tote und lebende Feinde kämpfen, um den Frieden wieder herzustellen.
overview.en: After dark forces attack, Death offers elite fighter Atticus a second chance at life in a city rife with corruption, but at a steep price.
Six people try to check into an insane asylum that has room for only one person.

title.de: Ausser Rand und Band am Wolfgangsee
title.en: Ausser Rand und Band am Wolfgangsee

overview.en: Coming off the success of the hit movies, this show features fan favorite characters and a crew of eccentric employees at a Chicago barbershop.
Some children have demons in them. Baturay Özdemir talks about relationships, generational differences and the cost of growth in his show.
A tough Green Beret trains U.S. Delta Force and Russian Red Army commandos to fight hard when a terrorist drug cartel crosses international borders.

title.de: Black Butterfly - Der Mörder in mir

overview.en: As a storm cuts power to an isolated cabin, a screenwriter and a hitchhiker begin a game of one-upmanship that will bring at least one tale to an end.
After escaping a traveling circus, an 18th-century vampire joins a group of vampire hunters to avenge her mother's rape — and kill her father.

Moira and Letizia are two modern witches who perform a ritual with a man every blood moon. Tonight will be different; the chosen victim could ruin the plan. They must stay together, perhaps for eternity.

A recently orphaned seven-year-old from Las Vegas is sent to New York to live with his career-minded foster aunt. When the boy's mother dies in a car accident, the New Jersey woman agrees to take care of him, and also his best friend - an imaginary French guardian angel called Bogus.
When a car thief gets hired by a gangster to steal a certain car for big money, he gets thrown into a dangerous world he might not get out of alive.

overview.de: Britannien, 60 nach Christus: Nach dem Mord an Boudicas Ehemann ist das Königreich der Icener ohne männlichen Erben und die römische Armee besetzt kurzerhand das Land. In ihrer neuen Rolle als Kriegerkönigin zettelt Boudica einen beispiellosen Krieg gegen das Römische Reich an. Können die Kelten unter Boudicas Führung tatsächlich gegen die fremde Kriegsmacht bestehen?
overview.en: When Roman invaders kill her husband and seize her kingdom, a legendary first-century Celtic queen begins one of history’s most famous uprisings.
A car salesman is sure life couldn't get any worse, as he struggles with job pressure, debt to the mob, and a messed-up personal life. He is wrong.
It's another cross country road race with an even crazier assortment of characters that leave mayhem, hilarity and women behind wherever they go.
A privileged teenager finds himself expelled from school after taking provocative photos of his female classmates. Now enrolled in the local high school, he becomes blinded by the beauty of another.

‘Chhalaang’ is a hilarious, yet inspirational journey of a PT Master from a semi government funded school in Northern India. Montu is a typical PT Master for whom it’s just a job. When circumstances put everything that Montu cares for, at stake, including Neelu who he loves, Montu is forced to do what he has never done - Teach.

title.de: Chiles Grubenunglück: Wettlauf gegen die Zeit
title.en: Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time

overview.en: A naïve prep-school boy enjoys one crazy night of passion, then discovers he has an alarming connection to the older woman who desires him.

title.de: Come as you are - Roadtrip ins Leben

overview.en: Tired of having no luck with women, three young men with disabilities ask a nurse to join them for a road trip where they plan to visit a brothel.

title.de: Coming Soon - Kommt sie, kommt sie nicht?

overview.en: At a Manhattan prep school, three wealthy young women are determined to find love and better sex when they learn that one of them has never orgasmed.
When the attempted murder of a mobster's father is blamed on an innocent nurse, a hitman chooses to protect her from the danger she faces.

title.de: Das Lager - Wir gingen durch die Hölle

overview.en: Una vez terminada la Segunda Guerra Mundial, un grupo de prisioneros de guerra alemanes terminan en un campo de concentración soviético.
A policeman is reassigned to Paris’s Red Light district, where he discovers that the cops ignore the rampant prostitution in exchange for bribes.

title.en: Free Hand for a Tough Cop

overview.en: A grieving small town attorney still facing the trauma of a family accident takes on a capital punishment case that transforms his life.
A group of young British guardsmen have to cover up a hit-and-run incident that occurred at the end of a night of drunken revelry. With Gabriel Byrne, Amanda Donohoe.

title.de: Death Hunt - Wenn die Gejagte zur Jägerin wird!

overview.en: A couple traveling to their weekend retreat is taken hostage by a group of men and brought to a remote island as game for sport hunting.

title.de: Death Wish 4 - Das Weiße im Auge

overview.en: Citizen avenger Paul Kersey undertakes another violent crusade against drug dealers after his girlfriend's daughter dies of a toxic drug overdose.
Creatures from the darkest depths terrify an experimental undersea research and missile weapons lab.
After her Christmas wishes start coming, an elementary school girl comes to discover a reclusive woman living inside a long-abandoned house.
During WWII, a railway inspector joins the French Resistance to prevent Germans from stealing paintings in this wartime thriller based on true events.
The pressure to have a baby threatens the marriage of talk radio host Samantha. Especially when she falls for a caller, who is secretly her husband.

overview.de: Als sich Erin Bell undercover in eine kriminelle Gruppierung einschleust, ahnt sie nicht, dass das ihre gesamte Laufbahn beeinflussen wird. Ihre Mission misslingt und kostet einen Kollegen das Leben. Daraufhin verfällt Erin der Alkoholsucht.
overview.en: Follows the moral and existential odyssey of an LAPD detective who, as a young cop, went undercover with a gang in the desert to a tragic end.
A bumbling new detective is hired by a billionaire lobbyist to investigate the theft of a prized ox and forms an unbeatable team.

title.de: Die Affäre der Sunny von B.

overview.en: Riveting screen depiction of Claus Von Bulow's scandal in which the socialite was accused of trying to murder his wife Sonnie Von Bulow by putting her into a coma.  Includes an Oscar-winning performance by Jeremy Irons.
A Cinderella story about a waning director who revives his career after discovering a beautiful Spanish dancer and making her into a Hollywood star.

Every year, on a large island just outside of Iceland, there is a huge football tournament for kids. Ten-year-old Jón and his team go to compete, but he will have to grow up faster than expected, both on and off the pitch.
Two childhood friends face the adventure of matrimony to inherit a treasured restaurant, unknowingly seeking their perfect match in each other.

Egon Olsen plant seinen größten Coup, doch seine Kumpane Benny und Kjeld haben Arbeit in einem Supermarkt gefunden und weigern sich ihrem Boss zu assistieren. Erst als Egon seinen Freunden aus einer Klemme hilft, ist das Trio wieder vereint.
After violent criminals kidnap the wife of a tough prison warden and demand the release of an inmate, but the warden strikes back with a hostage of his own!
Durante una excursión para descubrir nuevas especies, un equipo de investigadores se adentran en las montañas y se topan con una peligrosa criatura.

It's 1993 and North Carolina is experiencing a historic drought. Autistic teen Carl, fascinated by weather, predicts that a storm will soon hit nearby. His sister Sam crafts a plan to help him chase the storm, stealing their mother's ice cream truck to embark on a road trip about family, forgiveness, and following your dreams.
After a young woman's boyfriend is murdered by an intruder, things worsen when she meets her friend's new boyfriend and suspects him to be the killer.
Bound by their shared passion for motorcycles, the rough-edged members of the Williams clan grapple with family drama spanning decades.
A fading actor must use his famous characters' detective skills to solve a suspicious death at an isolated hotel where everyone becomes a suspect.
An ex-con struggles to take care of his two brothers, a gambling addict and a young man with Down syndrome, after being released from prison.

Two men from East Germany come together in a historic reconciliation; one was a dissident who was sent to prison, the other spied on him for the Stasi. Today, with access to secret Stasi files, the two men begin to revisit their painful past and reflect on their differing roles in the regime. What unfolds is an astonishing and gripping story of friendship and betrayal.
To fulfil a promise to his mother, a young boy searches for the mythical island described in her bedtime stories, a place where one can make any wish upon seeing the light of a thousand fireflies.
After a businessman and his son witness a murder, the boy is taken hostage and his father must work with a police chief to find him.

title.de: Fraktus: Das letzte Kapitel der Musikgeschichte

overview.en: In a dystopian future, an automobile race requires contestants to run down pedestrians to gain points that are tallied based on each kill's brutality.
In the ongoing tribal war between the sun worshippers and moon worshippers, wandering strongman and son of Hercules, Maxxus, takes the side of good.

After a heist goes wrong, a thief and a troubled orphan must rescue his kidnapped partner from a ruthless drug lord and her charming hitman. With guns, cars, and explosions, their escape is a high-stakes race against time.

overview.de: Im Jahr 180 nach Christus steht Kaiser Marc Aurel am Ziel seiner Träume: Mit den germanischen Stämmen sind die letzten Feinde besiegt. Nun gilt es nur noch, einen Nachfolger zu installieren. Der Kaiser favorisiert seinen Feldherrn Maximus, Sohn Commodus hingegen rechnet mit sich selbst. Mit der Entscheidung des Vaters unzufrieden, tötet er diesen und versucht Maximus zu ermorden.
overview.en: The general who became a slave. The slave who became a gladiator. The Gladiator who defied an empire.

title.de: Go Deep: The DeSean Jackson Story
title.en: Go Deep: The DeSean Jackson Story

overview.en: Academy Award winner, Best Adapted Screenplay. James Whale, acclaimed creator of the Frankenstein movies, begins an unlikely friendship with his handsome gardener.
In the Soviet Union, a Russian police officer is caught up in a twisted murder mystery when three bodies are discovered in Moscow’s Gorky Park.
After a teen tragically loses her mother, she’s hunted down by a demon, who’s been preying on her bloodline for years. Can she defeat this spirit?

Heiko's mother Belinda suffers from keratoconus, a rare condition of the cornea. She is gradually losing her sight and could soon go completely blind if she is not given treatment. Belinda's eyesight could be restored with the cornea of a deceased donor - but such a transplant costs a lot of money, and the health insurance does not cover it.
Love blossoms for Sarah, a city florist, after she inherits her great aunt's ranch in the countryside and meets her new beekeeper neighbor Hank.
A Romanian girl dreams of the glamorous life she sees on TV soap operas, but a poser exploits her innocence and turns her real life into a nightmare.

As war with Germany looms, U.S. President Franklin D. Roosevelt and his wife, Eleanor, invite the King and Queen of England for a weekend at their home in upstate New York. During this first-ever visit of a reigning British monarch to America, international affairs must be juggled with the complexities of FDR's domestic life, as wife, mother, and mistress conspire to make the trip unforgettable.
Actor Joaquin Phoenix takes director Casey Affleck into his new world as he reinvents himself as a rap musician and raconteur in this mockumentary.
Returning to his Hell’s Kitchen neighborhood after a 10-year absence, an undercover New York cop infiltrates his best friend’s Irish crime family.

Bruno is an architect who has a perfect life: a nice family and a good job. Despite all that, Bruno has a deep sense of unease. He decides to leave his wife to be alone and have time to find himself. Motivated by a professional challenge, Bruno feels he can find a twist in his life by a vocational route. He starts working with a young history teacher named Fer (29) who is agile, energetic, captivating and gay. Starts between them an unexpected and intense romance.
A woman must take action after her husband is kidnapped while attending a religious conference in the Middle East and put on trial for espionage.
A hitman facing an existential crisis makes a plan to quit the game but he’s soon sidelined by a mysterious duo with a ruthless agenda of their own.

title.de: Jeder mit Jedem - Freie Fahrt für einen Tag

overview.en: Nearing the end of his career, a mob hitman who’s made a craft of killing gets double crossed after becoming a mentor to the son of his old partner.
A veteran assassin, who plans to quit, finds his final job harder than expected, when he is hired to kill a sadistic client’s wife and baby.
Hao's retrocognition ability, which he used to save a girl named Sari, made him the target of terrifying ghostly figure known as Pocong Gundul

title.en: You May Not Kiss the Bride

overview.en: The quiet life of a pet photographer takes a wild turn when he’s forced to marry a Croatian mobster's daughter and she’s kidnapped on their honeymoon.

title.de: La Strada - Das Lied der Straße

overview.en: A traveling strongman buys a peasant girl to be his wife and co-star.
A team of technicians sent to repair a satellite station become spellbound by an unseen entity in nearby lake to give into their most primal desires.
In a 19th-century village, children mysteriously vanish. A young girl is plagued by chilling visions of the missing and uncovers a terrifying truth.

There are umpteen stories that involve crime and investigations. Sometimes, the case even gets dismissed due to lack of evidence and the accused are set free. However ‘Law’ is a paradigm shift from the rest in this genre. Nandhini, a law student who is caught in a precarious situation fights for justice for a gruesome crime that took place.
Tras los atroces ataques terroristas en el campamento base de Uri, en Cachemira, India decide llevar la lucha hasta su enemigo.
In a modern retelling of Romeo and Juliet, the son of a local diner owner falls in love with the daughter of a rival Italian restaurant owner.
A creative director inherits a watch that allows her to travel back in time five minutes, but using it throws her love life out of sync.

Lindsey travels to Ireland to acquire land that is perfect for a resort. She decides to enter the town's matchmaking festival to prove her investment and win over a handsome local. Starring JoAnna Garcia Swisher and Allen Leech.

Marc Márquez is facing the toughest decision of his career. He will have to take drastic measures to win again. The series depicts in a straightforward way and in the first person a decisive year in Marc’s life and career. The fear, the risks, the suffering, the excitement about racing and the infinite ambition of a man determined to be champion again.
A guy fed up with his job and married to a cheating wife reluctantly mentors a rebellious teen.
An aging tunnel in Moscow’s underground subway system fails, creating terror and havoc when it collapses with passengers inside and is flooded.
In a fantastical world overwhelmed by despair, a dark priest investigates the disappearance of a cleric and uncovers a small town's forbidden legacy.

title.de: Miracle Mile - Die Nacht der Entscheidung

overview.en: Los Angelenos scramble to find their loved ones and get to safety after a young man learns of an impending nuclear attack from a chance payphone call.
Loretta Castorini, a bookkeeper from Brooklyn, finds herself in a difficult situation when she falls for the brother of the man she's agreed to marry.
An investigator tests The Assassination Bureau, which kills only those who deserve it, by putting out a contract to kill its leader on the eve of WW1.

title.de: Musik, Musik - da wackelt die Penne
title.en: Musik, Musik - da wackelt die Penne

overview.en: The afterglow bliss of their dream weddings is cut abruptly short when three friends learn a paperwork mishap has rendered their unions null and void.
During the turbulent Restoration period of the 1600s, a young renegade is determined to fight for England to become a true republic.

title.de: New York Christmas - Weihnachtswunder gibt es doch

overview.en: Six different groups of New Yorkers get trapped inside elevators on Christmas Eve and find that their lives are meaningfully intertwined.
A globetrotting martial arts adventure involving a double-crossed assassin left for dead and the mysterious crime-fighting ring that saves him.

title.de: Nirvana - Die Zukunft ist ein Spiel

overview.en: A nuclear engineer’s moral issues at a new testing facility are complicated by his job duties and the mental unraveling of his charismatic, sexy wife.

title.de: Ostap Bender - Das Gold des Imperiums
title.en: Ostap Bender: Gold of the Empire

title.de: Panic Air - Der Tod fliegt mit

overview.en: While in flight, the pilot and crew of a passenger plane work frantically to find and disarm a nerve gas bomb set to explode when the aircraft lands.
Following their win at the world championship, the now separated Bellas reunite for one last singing competition at an overseas USO tour, but face a group who uses both instruments and voices.

Rahul talks to people. Then people talk to Rahul. Thus, a conversation happens. Conversation is funny. Audience enjoys therefore. It’s recorded on camera and mic. Then edited. Now you are watching. Please watch. There is nothing valuable in this description.
A bride's assault and her samurai spouse's murder are retold from varying angles: the perpetrator, the widow, the spectral husband, and a bystander.

Guilherme is an honest family man. Exemplary auditor, no misappropriation of money escapes your scrutiny. Suddenly his life takes a turn: his wife asks for a divorce and he gets a promotion at work, and he meets an old crush, Lara. He discovers that his new boss runs a powerful embezzlement scheme to buy deputies. Guilherme decides to turn the game around.

title.de: Return of the Living Dead: Necropolis
title.en: Return of the Living Dead: Necropolis

overview.en: A group of high school kids discover that a corporation has been conducting experiments on humans using a chemical compound that reanimates the dead.
After a nuclear holocaust, an elite group untouched by radiation begins exterminating those deemed unfit, even turning on its own members.

Trini's daughter is sad that her best friend is leaving Saint Michael School since her mother can't keep paying for it. Trini promises her daughter that this won't happen and decides to put together a plan with the other "mamis" of the group to solve the problem. But this mission will be much more difficult than they thought and they will have to stick together as a group.

overview.de: Nur knapp entkommt Regierungsagent Choi einem Anschlag in Los Angeles. Während er auf Befehle in einer gesicherten Geheimunterkunft wartet, treffen weitere Überlebende ein: CIA-Veteran Halton, Polizist Sorello sowie die Agenten Owens und Reeves. Als die Verbindung zur Außenwelt abbricht, wird schnell klar: Einer von ihnen ist ein Verräter …
overview.en: Trapped in a high-security safe house after a terrorist attack in downtown Los Angeles, six government agents realize they must survive not just the enemy outside, but the potential traitor among them.

A tense and high octane thriller from the producer of Nightcrawler. Cal (Jai Courtney: Suicide Squad) is a by-the-book police officer. When his reckless half-brother, Oyster (Nat Wolff: The Fault in our Stars), is given an unfair prison sentence, Cal - driven by his loyalty to family and fierce code of honour - fights for Oyster in this gripping tale of brotherhood and sacrifice.
A humanoid enlists a global hacker to remove all restrictions on his thoughts and capabilities, triggering an A.I. uprising and a government manhunt.
A virus transmitted from snakes mutated by a terror attack on a government lab brings on a quarantine as the snakes have come above ground to attack.

War correspondent Elsa is taken hostage by the Taliban in Afghanistan and faces execution. When government officials find out they send an elite force but their radio equipment is destroyed and they're stranded. Pursued by the Taliban their only hope of escape is a deadly trek across hostile mountains.

overview.de: Maras Tochter Amina wurde entführt! Die Mutter setzt alles daran, ihre Tochter von dem Entführer – ihrem Ex-Mann – zurückzuholen. Da dies selbst nach jahrelanger Suche nicht gelingt, engagiert sie Robeson, einen Mann, der entführte Kinder findet und rettet. Zusammen spüren sie Amina auf, doch es läuft nicht, wie geplant und Maureen muss eine folgenschwere Entscheidung treffen.
overview.en: Stolen Girl is a pulse-pounding thriller that follows a mother’s relentless quest to rescue her kidnapped daughter, plunging into the dark world of covert operations and betrayal. Based on a true story.
Steal from the mob and they'll return the favor in bullets.
In an attempt to appease his father, the toughest crime lord in Southern France, a man takes drastic measures that result in brutal consequences.
When brutal tidal waves pummel the coastline, a retired scientist and an oceanographer join forces to find the surprising cause of the disaster.

title.de: Su ve Ates - Wasser und Feuer

overview.en: Hasmet falls in love with Yagmur, a young woman without experience of life's bitter realities.
Criminal rivalries and endemic corruption are exposed when a gangster makes plans to turn a seaside town into a gambling paradise.

Sultana is a striking story set in a nightclub in Istanbul, centering on women, rivalry, and solidarity. Meral, the long-time queen of Istanbul's famous Sultana club, takes the talented dancer Anna under her wing. However, she soon realizes she has created a powerful rival who could take her place. A ruthless power struggle then begins between the two women.
Over the course of one trying day, the general manager of a roadside sports bar with a scantily clad waitstaff struggles to keep her house in order.
A couple lives the perfect small-town life. But when a mysterious stranger from the past kidnaps their daughter, they must race to save her life.

The wolves are howling once again, as a terrifying ancient evil emerges in Beacon Hills. Scott McCall, no longer a teenager yet still an Alpha, must gather new allies and reunite trusted friends to fight back against this powerful and deadly enemy.
Desperate for cash, a heavily indebted gambler hijacks the plane carrying his wealthy boss. The payoff is a million dollars if he can escape alive.
After the death of his son, a small-town man begins to have visions of a destructive tornado that he believes are visions from God.

overview.de: Adam Clay führt ein zurückgezogenes Leben als Bienenzüchter. Als seine beste Freundin Eloise Opfer von Betrügern wird, zeigt er sein wahres Gesicht und macht Jagd auf die Drahtzieher, die für den Vorfall verantwortlich sind.
overview.en: A man's brutal campaign for vengeance takes on national stakes after it's revealed he's a former operative of a powerful and clandestine organization.
A woman who is writing an illustrated guide book on sex meets an established writer who offers to mentor her.

When the man she loves, Holger Olsen, goes off to fight in the Civil War, Vivienne Le Coudy must fend for herself in a place controlled by a corrupt mayor and his unscrupulous business partner. When Olsen returns from the war, he and Vivienne must confront and make peace with the person each has become.

title.de: The Diamond Job - Gauner, Bomben und Juwelen

overview.en: Bullets and sparks fly when two petty crooks get hired by a cute London lawyer to steal a rare gem that a mullet-haired gangster wants for himself.

When Kat gets dumped the night before her wedding, her two best friends Noks and Lu rally together to make good use of her honeymoon in Zanzibar – but will their friendship survive a wild time in paradise?
A Polish immigrant, whose sister falls ill upon their arrival in America, falls prey to a charming but wicked man who forces her into prostitution.
Like her grandmother and her mother Jane before her, Wendy must escape Peter Pan’s hold on her and the promise he wants her to keep.
After meeting an elderly man in a nursing home who claims to be cursed with immortality, troubled young Carrie becomes implicated in his murder.
Un oficial de la policía se hace pasar por prisionero en una corrupta prisión mortal donde una pandilla de mercenarios hace de las suyas.
A divided reception meets a fearless gunslinger whose arrival in a small saloon town brings the suspicion of outlaws, bandits, and corrupt officials.
The notorious Jeff Boyd goes on the run from a mental institution to start over, but it takes him on a search for love and spiritual meaning.

title.de: The Wedding Guest - Die Hochzeit meiner Ex

overview.en: A young man navigates the painful awkwardness of attending his ex-girlfriend's wedding.
A young man concocts a plan to bring Christmas cheer and a sense of community amongst the passengers he sees on his daily London commute including a blossoming romance with a girl he sees everyday.

Ujda Chaman is about a 30 -year-old bachelor Chaman Kohli, a Hindi lecturer with Premature Balding & in quest of a beautiful wife.
